Scored with built-in banks: 60+ power words, 40+ emotional words. Length targets: 55–70 characters, 6–9 words.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your headline or blog title.
  2. Get an instant score from length, word count and word-type balance.
  3. Swap in power words and emotional words suggested from the built-in banks to raise the score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the score calculated?

Length (ideal 55–70 chars / 6–9 words), presence of power words, emotional words, uncommon words and numbers each add points, for a 0–100 score graded A–F.

What are power words?

High-impact words like "proven", "secret", "ultimate", "free", "guaranteed" — the tool checks against a built-in bank of 60+ of them.

Is a high score a guarantee of clicks?

No — it measures headline craft, not audience fit. A "B" headline your readers care about beats an "A" they ignore.
